## Audience and problem

Who needed this and why?

## Research and design

What evidence changed your features, branding, layout, or scope? Show one link: source observation → audience need → promise/voice/visual choice → feature and check. Link the existing style guide; explain a persuasion element without claiming an unmeasured effect.

## Implementation and my contribution

What did you build? How does it work? For group work, identify your own contribution and the integration with others.

## AI use and verification

One concrete example of AI assistance, what you changed, and how you verified it.

## Result and learning

Screenshots with captions, actual QA/review evidence, feedback-driven changes, known limitations, and next steps. Include measured results only when supported by data.

## Attribution

Sources for imagery, fonts, text, code, and external resources where applicable.
